name: vscode-cdn-extension
description: Language support for CDN (CBOR-EDN): syntax highlighting, validation, and formatting.
author: Yasuhiro Kudo <ykudo@ykudo.org>

enumDescriptions: The document must contain exactly one CDN data item (matches the application/cdn media type).
The document may contain multiple CDN data items separated by whitespace or commas (CBOR sequence).
cdn.validate.topLevel.description: How the top level of a CDN document is validated and formatted.

enumDescriptions: Emit commas including a trailing comma
cdn.format.commas.description: Comma style used by the formatter for arrays and maps.

enumDescriptions: Keep comments with their original markers.
Normalize line comments to // and block comments to /* … */.
Normalize line comments to # and block comments to / … /.

cdn.format.encodingIndicators.description: Whether the formatter emits CBOR encoding-width indicators (_N).

cdn.format.appStrings.description: Prefer application-oriented literal notation (e.g. dt'2023-01-01T00:00:00Z') over raw tag notation when formatting.

cdn.format.bstrEncoding.description: Fallback byte-string encoding used by the formatter when the original spelling is not preserved.

cdn.format.preserveByteString.description: Keep the original spelling of byte-string literals (h'…', b64'…', '…') when formatting.

cdn.format.preserveRawString.description: Keep the original spelling of raw backtick string literals (`…`) instead of converting them to double-quoted form.

cdn.format.preserveConcatenation.description: Keep `+` string concatenation chains ("a" + "b", h'01' + h'02') from the source instead of joining them into a single literal.

cdn.format.splitCdn.description: Split text strings whose content parses as CDN using `+` concatenation with structure-aware indentation.

cdn.format.splitNewline.description: Split text strings at newline characters using `+` concatenation.

cdn.format.inlineLeafContainers.description: Keep arrays/maps that contain no nested containers on a single line (e.g. [1, 2, 3]) when formatting.

cdn.extensions.dt.description: Enable dt'…'/DT'…' date-time literals (tags 1/0). Mandatory-to-implement per draft-ietf-cbor-edn-literals-26 §2.1.

cdn.extensions.ip.description: Enable ip'…'/IP'…' IP address/prefix literals (tags 52/54). Mandatory-to-implement per draft-ietf-cbor-edn-literals-26 §2.1.

cdn.extensions.cri.description: Enable cri'…'/CRI'…' Constrained Resource Identifier literals (tag 99).

cdn.extensions.t1.description: Enable t1'…' interoperable text literals. Mandatory-to-implement per draft-ietf-cbor-edn-literals-26 §2.1.

cdn.extensions.b1.description: Enable b1'…' byte-string literals. Mandatory-to-implement per draft-ietf-cbor-edn-literals-26 §2.1.

cdn.extensions.ilbs.description: Enable ilbs'…' indefinite-length byte string literals.

cdn.extensions.ilts.description: Enable ilts'…' indefinite-length text string literals.
